title: HullQ SLICE-0030 Artifact Digests
description: SHA256 integrity digests covering every retained SLICE-0030 package file except this document itself.

digests.description: Covers every retained package file except ARTIFACT-DIGESTS.json itself, discovered dynamically from the package directory (never a hardcoded allowlist) by hullq.bootstrap.wikidata_sl0030_mass_unit_correction.build_artifact_digests / verify_artifact_digests_self_consistency. The base entries are always present once --replay has run. REPLAY-RESULT.json/REPLAY-REPORT.md are additionally required once --persist has run; they are absent (and therefore not required here) in the intermediate post---replay-only state.
